_comment: AryaVeda shop catalogue. Loaded by backend/seed_shop.py (idempotent, matched by slug). New products are created as DRAFTS (hidden): a product with requires_licence can only be published once its licence_number is filled in (admin -> Shop Products). Products with requires_licence false (tools, books, decor, textiles, gifts) can be published straight away. Copy avoids medical claims ('traditionally used', 'conditions', not 'cures'). Variant labels are the net quantity / shade printed on the pack; price is the MRP in INR incl. taxes. Images in shop/images/<slug>.jpg are AI-generated and shown labelled 'Illustrative image' until a real product photo is uploaded.

products.name: Natural Henna Powder (Body-Art Quality)
products.description: Triple-sifted, finely milled Lawsonia inermis leaf powder for smooth, crack-free mehndi paste and a rich natural stain.
products.ingredients: 100% henna leaf powder (Lawsonia inermis). No PPD, no added colour.
products.how_to_use: Mix with lemon juice or water, a little sugar and a few drops of mehndi oil to a yoghurt-like paste. Cover and rest 6-12 hours before filling cones.
products.safety_notes: Do a patch test 24 hours before use. For external use only. Keep out of reach of children.
products.storage: Store sealed in a cool, dry, dark place.

products.name: Ready-to-use Natural Mehndi Cones
products.description: Freshly made natural henna cones with a fine tip - no chemicals, for a deep reddish-brown stain.
products.ingredients: Henna leaf powder, lemon juice, sugar, eucalyptus and clove essential oils.
products.how_to_use: Snip the tip, apply, let dry and keep on 6-8 hours. Scrape off - do not wash with water for 12 hours. The stain deepens over 48 hours.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. Contains essential oils - not for children under 6 or during pregnancy without advice. External use only.
products.shelf_life: 7 days at room temperature, 6 months frozen
products.storage: Keep refrigerated or frozen until use.

products.name: Bridal Dark-Stain Mehndi Cones
products.description: Small-batch bridal cones made fresh to order with premium henna and extra resting time for the darkest natural stain.
products.ingredients: Premium henna leaf powder, lemon juice, sugar, eucalyptus, clove and lavender essential oils.
products.how_to_use: Use within 3 days of delivery or freeze. Keep the paste on for 8-12 hours for bridal depth.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. Contains essential oils - not for children or during pregnancy without advice. External use only.

products.name: Nail Mehndi Cones
products.description: Thicker henna paste made to stain nails a natural orange-red - the traditional way to colour nails.
products.ingredients: Henna leaf powder, lemon juice, sugar.
products.how_to_use: Coat clean, unpolished nails and leave on 2-3 hours. Scrape off.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. External use only.

products.name: Fresh Henna Paste Jar
products.description: Ready-mixed natural henna paste for artists who fill their own cones or bottles.
products.ingredients: Henna leaf powder, lemon juice, sugar, eucalyptus essential oil.
products.how_to_use: Thaw in the fridge, stir, then fill cones or an applicator bottle.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. Contains essential oil. External use only.
products.storage: Ships frozen. Keep frozen until use.

products.name: Mehndi Oil (Eucalyptus & Clove)
products.description: A traditional blend added to henna paste to help release dye, and dabbed on skin before applying mehndi.
products.ingredients: Eucalyptus oil, clove oil, cajeput oil in a sesame oil base.
products.how_to_use: Add a few drops per 100 g of henna while mixing, or dab lightly on skin before applying.
products.safety_notes: Strong essential oils - never use undiluted on skin, not for children or during pregnancy, keep away from eyes.
products.storage: Keep tightly closed, away from heat and sunlight.

products.name: Lemon-Sugar Mehndi Sealant Spray
products.description: A light spray that keeps drying mehndi paste moist and in contact with the skin for a deeper stain.
products.ingredients: Lemon juice, sugar, purified water, natural preservative.
products.how_to_use: Once the paste is touch-dry, mist lightly 2-3 times over the next hour.
products.safety_notes: External use only. Avoid eyes.

products.name: Clove Mehndi Aftercare Balm
products.description: A soft balm smoothed over fresh mehndi after scraping, traditionally used to protect and darken the stain.
products.ingredients: Shea butter, coconut oil, beeswax, clove oil.
products.how_to_use: After scraping off the paste, warm a little balm between your palms and smooth over the design.
products.safety_notes: Contains clove oil - not for children under 6. External use only.

products.name: Clove Mehndi Stain Booster Pouch
products.description: Whole cloves for the traditional clove-steam - warming the hands over clove smoke after mehndi.
products.how_to_use: Heat a few cloves on a tawa and hold your hands well above the gentle smoke for a few minutes.
products.safety_notes: Use with adult supervision. Keep hands at a safe distance from heat.

products.name: Pure Henna Hair Powder
products.description: Natural henna for hair - gives a red-copper tint and is traditionally used to condition and add shine.
products.how_to_use: Mix with warm water or tea to a smooth paste, rest 4-6 hours, apply to clean hair, keep 1-2 hours, rinse.
products.safety_notes: Patch test 24 hours before use. Not for use on chemically treated hair within 2 weeks. Avoid eyes.

products.name: Henna, Amla, Shikakai & Reetha Hair Pack
products.description: A classic herbal hair pack blending henna with amla, shikakai and reetha, traditionally used for clean, soft, glossy hair.
products.how_to_use: Mix with water to a paste, apply to hair for 45-60 minutes, rinse well.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. Avoid eyes. External use only.

products.name: Henna & Bhringraj Hair Mask
products.description: Henna with bhringraj and brahmi - a traditional Ayurvedic-style hair mask for conditioning and shine.
products.how_to_use: Mix with warm water or curd, apply for 45 minutes, rinse.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. Avoid eyes. External use only.

products.name: Indigo Leaf Powder
products.description: Natural indigo (Indigofera tinctoria) used after henna to take hair to brown or black shades.
products.how_to_use: Two-step: henna first, then indigo mixed with water and applied straight away for 1-2 hours.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. Wear gloves. Avoid eyes. External use only.
products.storage: Store sealed, dry and away from light.

products.name: Henna-Indigo Natural Hair Colour
products.description: Ready blends of henna, indigo and herbs for a one-step natural colour in four shades.
products.ingredients: Henna, indigo, amla, cassia - proportions vary by shade.
products.how_to_use: Mix with water, apply to clean hair, keep 2-3 hours, rinse without shampoo. Colour settles over 2 days.
products.safety_notes: Patch test 48 hours before use. Wear gloves. Avoid eyes. Not for eyebrows or lashes.

products.name: Mehndi Hair Oil
products.description: Fresh henna leaves slow-infused in coconut and sesame oil - a traditional oil for hair and scalp massage.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, sesame oil, henna leaf extract, curry leaf, hibiscus.
products.how_to_use: Massage into scalp and hair, leave for an hour or overnight, then wash.
products.safety_notes: Patch test first. External use only.

products.name: Henna Herbal Hair Cleanser
products.description: A mild shikakai and reetha cleanser with henna leaf, made to wash hair without stripping natural colour.
products.ingredients: Shikakai, reetha, henna leaf extract, aloe vera, purified water, mild cleanser.
products.how_to_use: Lather on wet hair, massage gently and rinse.
products.safety_notes: Avoid eyes. External use only.

products.name: Henna Leave-in Conditioning Cream
products.description: A light leave-in cream with henna leaf extract and aloe to soften hair after natural colouring.
products.ingredients: Aloe vera, coconut oil, shea butter, henna leaf extract.
products.how_to_use: Smooth a small amount through damp hair. Do not rinse.
products.safety_notes: External use only.

products.name: Beard & Moustache Henna
products.description: A natural henna-indigo blend for beards and moustaches in a natural brown shade.
products.how_to_use: Mix a small amount with water, apply to beard for 45-60 minutes, rinse.
products.safety_notes: Patch test 48 hours before use. Keep away from eyes and lips.

products.name: Brow Henna Tint
products.description: A henna-based brow tint for professional brow artists.
products.ingredients: Henna and plant-based colourants (final formula per your licensed manufacturer).
products.how_to_use: Professional use only, following the manufacturer's instructions.
products.safety_notes: Patch test 48 hours before every use. Used near the eyes - only to be sold after eye-area safety testing by the manufacturer.

products.name: Mehndi Leaf Handmade Soap
products.description: A cold-process soap with henna leaf and neem - a gentle, earthy, everyday bar.
products.ingredients: Coconut oil, olive oil, sodium hydroxide (saponified), henna leaf powder, neem leaf, essential oil.
products.how_to_use: Lather and rinse. Keep dry between uses.
products.safety_notes: External use only. Avoid eyes.
products.storage: Keep on a draining soap dish.

products.name: Henna Foot Cream
products.description: A rich foot cream with henna leaf extract, traditionally valued for its cooling feel on dry, rough heels.
products.ingredients: Shea butter, coconut oil, beeswax, henna leaf extract, camphor.
products.how_to_use: Massage into clean, dry feet at night. Wear cotton socks for best results.
products.safety_notes: Not for broken skin. External use only.

products.name: Henna Cooling Foot Pack
products.description: A traditional henna and multani mitti pack for tired feet, used for its cooling, refreshing feel.
products.ingredients: Henna leaf powder, multani mitti, sandalwood powder, rose powder.
products.how_to_use: Mix with rose water, apply to feet for 15-20 minutes, rinse. May leave a light orange tint.
products.safety_notes: May tint skin. Patch test first. External use only.

products.name: Henna Cuticle & Nail Oil
products.description: A nourishing oil for nails and cuticles with henna leaf infusion and vitamin E.
products.ingredients: Almond oil, jojoba oil, henna leaf infusion, vitamin E.
products.how_to_use: Brush onto cuticles and massage in, daily.
products.safety_notes: Contains nut oil. External use only.

products.name: Henna Leaf Bath Ubtan
